Stamp Duty Calculator (SDLT)

If you're buying a property in the UK, you'll owe Stamp Duty Land Tax on the purchase. This calculator works it out for you, using the thresholds currently in force for 2025/2026.
blocks.2:
Current SDLT Thresholds (2026)

The temporary relief period ended in March 2025, so thresholds are back to standard levels. On top of that, if you're buying an additional property (Buy-to-Let/Second Home), there's a surcharge of 5%.

  • £0 - £125,000: 0%
  • £125,001 - £250,000: 2%
  • £250,001 - £925,000: 5%
  • £925,001 - £1.5m: 10%
  • Above £1.5m: 12%
